retry_arm: retry same logical release row once after first exception; count duplicate logical IDs per sink
controls: ExecutorV13 attempt-before-emit means no automatic retry; source disposition checked independently
decision: PASS_SCOPED if fault locations produce expected durable prefix counts, retry completes all destinations but duplicates a previously appended logical event when applicable, and no-retry policy avoids automatic duplicate while leaving partial-delivery uncertainty; any different result FAIL_SCOPED; source/hash/runtime mismatch STOP before injection
scope: Literal AST-extracted main emit function with private temp files and injected Python exceptions only. No production Executor instance, OS crash durability, GUI, game, X11, input, model, user data, or live task.
